_comment: #419 java pilot — complete classification of ALL 143 public named node types in the pinned tree-sitter-java wasm. Every type is bucketed; a type in no bucket is itself a gate failure (silence is guilt). Buckets: handled_verified (analyzer emits correctly, probe/fixture-confirmed), internal_silent (container/literal/keyword correctly emitting nothing itself), gap (confirmed missing emission, numbered G1..), design_decision (owner ruling required before closure). Generated mechanically + probe-verified 2026-08-26 (see script/m14/completeness-inventory.ts).

handled_verified._description: Node types whose required emissions are produced and verified by probes and/or existing F3 fixtures
handled_verified._verified_by: live analyzer probes on synthetic fixtures (record patterns aside) + existing F3 fixtures + differential corpus (grails-core@a83f87480e)

internal_silent._description: Containers, wrappers, grouping nodes, literals, and keywords whose named children are walked independently — emitting nothing at this node is correct

_notes.type_bound: generic bound container (T extends Number) — the bound TYPE reference is not emitted; tracked as design_decision G6, the container itself is correctly silent
_notes.template_expression: Java 21 string templates / text blocks — embedded expressions are walked and their calls/uses emitted; the template wrapper itself is silent
_notes.synchronized_statement: not a decision point per McCabe; block body walked
_notes.static_initializer: symbol: null per spec table; body IS walked but calls inside it are lost — tracked as gap G4

gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified: the analyzer emits nothing where the spec table requires an emission)

gaps.missing: Uses relationship on the array expression
gaps.evidence: probe: class A { int[] xs; void f(int i) { xs[i] = 5; int v = xs[i]; } } emits contains only — no uses on xs for reads or writes
probe: class A { A() { super(); } } emits no calls
gaps.spec_row: declarations.constructor_declaration — constructor delegation is a call edge

gaps.missing: Type reference for the record type in instanceof Point(int x, int y)
gaps.evidence: probe: if (o instanceof Point p) emits instanceof_check, but if (o instanceof Point(int a, int b)) emits nothing

gaps.missing: Calls relationships for invocations outside method bodies: static initializers, instance initializers, field initializers, enum constant bodies
gaps.evidence: probes: static { x = compute(); }, { x = compute(); }, static int x = compute(), enum { int x = compute(); } all emit no calls. Root cause: src/ast/real-java-analyzer.ts method_invocation handler guards on parentContext.kind === SymbolKind.Method, so calls attributed to no method scope are dropped; qualified_calls likewise never recorded

design_decision._description: Items where the correct emission is a ruling, not a defect. Closure requires an explicit owner decision recorded here

decisions.node_type: module_declaration, requires_module_directive, requires_modifier, exports_module_directive, opens_module_directive, uses_module_directive, provides_module_directive
decisions.question: module-info.java currently emits zero symbols and zero relationships. Options: (a) declare module-info out of scope (documented limitation), (b) emit requires/exports/uses targets as References/imports (dependency edges)
decisions.recommendation: (a) declare out of scope — module-info is rare, low-value for AI code understanding, and the analyzer already extracts imports elsewhere
decisions.ruling: (a) DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE — owner approval 2026-08-26. module-info.java is a documented limitation; requires/exports/opens/uses/provides emit no edges by design

decisions.question: generic bound types (class Box<T extends Number & Comparable<T>>) emit no type references for Number/Comparable. Options: (a) emit declared_type references for bounds, (b) declare limitation (bounds captured only as type_parameter names)
decisions.recommendation: (b) declare limitation — bounds are rarely load-bearing for AI consumers; type_parameters payload already records parameter names
decisions.ruling: (b) DECLARED LIMITATION — owner approval 2026-08-26. type_bound emits no type references; typeParameters payload carries the parameter names

decisions.question: java-spec-table.json lists these in statements_affecting_complexity, but calculateJavaMethodComplexity does not count them (standard McCabe counts only if/while/for/do/case/catch/&&/||/ternary). Either the spec table over-claims or the analyzer under-counts
decisions.recommendation: correct the spec table (remove from complexity list) — matches the analyzer, matches textbook McCabe, and keeps complexity comparable across JVM languages (CC1 contract)
decisions.ruling: SPEC TABLE CORRECTED — owner approval 2026-08-26: throw_statement, assert_statement, try_with_resources_statement removed from statements_affecting_complexity in java-spec-table.json

decisions.question: The analyzer queues override tasks only for methods carrying @Override. Most real Java omits the annotation (clojure/ASF code) — are un-annotated overrides relationships?
decisions.resolution: Yes — JLS 8.4.8: @Override is a compile-time check, not a requirement; an un-annotated instance method whose signature matches an accessible ancestor method overrides it. Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09 (clojure:java SubVector.iterator). The analyzer now queues implicit tasks for every non-static, non-private, non-constructor instance method, but emits ONLY on a verified exact-signature in-file match (pass 1). Explicit @Override tasks alone keep the companion-index (pass 2) and first-parent guess (pass 3) tiers, so overloads never fabricate.

decisions.question: The override TRUTH pairs by method NAME only — same-name-different-signature overloads (SubVector.nth(int) vs APersistentVector.nth(int, Object)) were asserted as overrides. Signature-exact?
decisions.resolution: Yes. Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09: the shared oracle collected members with the return type / nested-type-name bugs (the /identifier/ test matched type_identifier first and the field_declaration|declaration guard swallowed method_declaration AND let nested class_declaration through). All fixed: method names come from the grammar name field, member collection is field_declaration-only for variables with nested type nodes excluded, and override pair emission is signature-aware (parameter-type signature overlap required when both sides record signatures). Private ancestor methods never pair (JLS 8.4.8.1).
